question: Does the grouped light-theme control target imply ACT.primary or NDC checkout semantics merely because ScanButton appears in the selector?

authorityFound.finding: The exact selector group shares frosted light-theme styling. ScanButton has no data-prisma-primary="true" marker in this target and is grouped with inactive CategoryButton, IconButton and SearchBar.
Operational checkout meaning exists separately. No exact target relation binds this four-control visual group to checkout.

explicitNonEquivalence: The literal presence of ScanButton is insufficient to classify the whole grouped target as Identity ACT.primary. This exact selector omits the data-prisma-primary="true" marker used by the previously qualified primary ScanButton targets and also styles three non-primary controls. ACT.primary is also not equivalent to NDC ACT.sale.checkout.
